name: Simple Days
source: Simple Days story is based on simple days. One at a time… Your character is a young boy, just after his 19 years birthday. You will take control of his life …finding his first job, girlfriend(s), touching the shady life, encounter awkward situations, buying first car etc. Maybe will go after the money, maybe after study, maybe just start a family. Do you want to make your character a stand up guy or join the dark side? It will be up to you. The game will give you the choice.. but it is you, who will decide what will happen. It will start with simple days, but more simple days pass, more complicated and colorful the story will become.
translation: 《平凡岁月》的故事围绕着一天又一天的平凡日常展开……你将扮演一名刚满19岁的年轻小伙，全面接管他的人生——找第一份工作、交女朋友、试探灰色地带的边缘生活、应对尴尬窘境、买下人生第一辆车等等。或许你会一心追逐金钱，或许会潜心求学，又或许只想安稳成家。究竟要让他成为堂堂正正的好青年，还是堕入黑暗面？一切全凭你做主。游戏会为你提供选择……但最终决定命运走向的人是你。故事始于平淡无奇的日常，可随着日子一天天过去，你的人生画卷也将变得愈发错综复杂、多姿多彩。
